name: Priyagold Classic Creme Orange Flavoured Biscuits
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), SUGAR, REFINED VEGETABLE OILS (PALM OIL), MILK SOLIDS, LEAVENING AGENTS [AMMONIUM BICARBONATE (E503(ii)), SODIUM BICARBONATE (E500(ii))], LIQUID GLUCOSE, IODISED COMMON SALT, PERMITTED EMULSIFIERS [LECITHIN (E322(i)), DIACETYLTARTARIC AND FATTY ACID ESTERS OF GLYCEROL (E472(e)), ACIDITY REGULATOR [CITRIC ACID (E330)], DOUGH CONDITIONER [SODIUM METABISULPHITE (E 223)]. CONTAINS PERMITTED NATURAL FOOD COLOURS [ANNATTO EXTRACTS (E160(b)), ROSEMARY EXTRACT (E392), PAPRIKA EXTRACT (E160(c)] & SYNTHETIC FOOD COLOURS [ALLURA RED AC (E129), TARTRAZINE (E102)] & ADDED ARTIFICIAL FLAVOUR (ORANGE). ALLERGEN WARNING: THESE BISCUITS CONTAIN WHEAT, MILK, SULPHITE & SOY HYPERSENSITIVE INGREDIENTS.
